system.description:
Built on Project FU's Darkblade.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Hit Points
  • martial melee proficiency
  • martial armor proficiency

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Adopted from Project FU's Darkblade counterpart.)

BLACKGUARD SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000032]{Agony} 【Max SL 5】

Once per turn (anyone's turn), after you damage one or more enemies you have a Bond towards: recover (SL × 2) HP and (SL × 2) MP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000033]{Dark Blood} 【Max SL 1】

While in Crisis, Resistance to dark and poison.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000034]{Heart of Darkness} 【Max SL 1】

Once per scene, when you enter Crisis: create a Bond of hatred towards a creature you can see that you have no Bond towards.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000035]{Painful Lesson} 【Max SL 3】

After another creature costs you HP by any means: Study them for free, with +(SL) to the Check.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000036]{Shadow Strike} 【Max SL 5】

Action: roll your Might die and lose that many HP. If you are not at 0, perform a free attack dealing +(SL + the roll) damage — all of it dark, and the type cannot change.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000037]{Heart's Desire} 【Max SL 5】

You know the direction and general distance to each character you have a Bond toward, and gain +(SL) to Checks to gather information about them or close the distance.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000038]{Driven by Connection} 【Max SL 3】

Strengthening an existing Bond gives your next Check a bonus equal to its new strength. You may also hold up to (SL) extra Bonds, and your Bonds may carry a fourth emotion — comfort or tension.
